Similar to pinning a sticky post to the top of a subverse, it would be nice if mods could pin a "distinguished" mod comment to the top of a thread. For example, some posts break minor sub rules but end up generating a lot of discussion that mods don't want to remove, so often times a "distinguished" mod comment is a good compromise to remind users of the sub rules without removing the discussion in the process. Pinning the comment as a sticky would allow it to remain visible even if it's not voted up.

A few safeguards might be to only allow the pinning of distinguished mod comments, so that a mod can't self promote their regular comments without drawing obvious attention to the comment, and maybe even disabling votes on that comment so that the mod can't use the visibility of the post to encourage upvotes.

It's a small change, but it would be a welcome addition to the mod toolbox and fits the theme of existing sticky posts in subverses. I'd like to hear what you guys think and if there are any downsides I'm not thinking of.
